operations.name: Alden Whitman

expected.charges: Contempt of Congress for refusing to identify alleged Communist Party associates
expected.convicted: Convicted in 1957; conviction overturned in 1962 and later charges dismissed
expected.sentence: Suspended six-month sentence and $500 fine; no jail term served.
